label: PF Backlog 492
title: DOGFOOD P1: API auto-dogfood (POST /dogfood/run + GET /dogfood/runs/{id}) + delivery assertions

delivery.note: Phase 1: API auto-dogfood (composes run_entry) + tooling gate; merge --no-ff (no PR)

brief.problem: There was no API-first, auto-mode way to run a full product-generation dogfood (idea -> all stages/agents -> delivery) and observe each step; the previous dogfood only enqueued the pipeline and validated a profile.
brief.what_adds: POST /dogfood/run seeds the project (idea + auto_mode/auto_approve + tier + caps) and enqueues via the canonical run entry; GET /dogfood/runs/{id} aggregates run, stages/agents (events), log tail, defects, validation, and fail-closed delivery assertions.
brief.why: Prove the platform builds a product end-to-end through its own API, with observability at every step.
brief.who_feels: PF operators/maintainers running dogfood; future clients (CLI/UI) consuming the API.

objective: Drive a real product generation end-to-end via an on-demand API (idea -> all stages/agents -> stakeholder/HIL -> delivery), auto-mode, kctier, with per-stage observability and delivery assertions.
acceptance_criteria: POST /dogfood/run seeds project (idea + auto_mode/auto_approve + tier=kctier + caps) and enqueues via run_entry; returns run_id
GET /dogfood/runs/{id} aggregates run + stages + agents + events/log tail + defects + validation
delivery assertions (repo commits/branch, tests, close_loop) fail-closed
composes existing owners only (no new engine/store); does not bypass single submission path
tests cover start + status + delivery assertions
approach: Compose existing owners only (run_entry is the ONE submission path; project_store seeds; run_guard/log_router/validation_engine/issues/vcs/close_loop are read models). API-first; no new engine/store. Wired through a tooling gate because the invocation audit does not scan api/.

prior_decisions: Product generation via run_entry + executor, not workers (BI-PF-0427)
assumptions: local-only delivery OK when no remote
divergences: New API surface POST /dogfood/run + GET /dogfood/runs/{id} (new path, approved)
open_questions: new /dogfood endpoints vs extend /intake (chose new, approved)

risks: API-only module needs a tooling reference (invocation audit does not scan api/)
rollback: revert the merge (remove the endpoints + module)
summary: Adds an on-demand, API-driven, auto-mode dogfood that runs a real product generation end-to-end and reports per-step observability with fail-closed delivery assertions.

analysis.implementation_strategy: Extend existing components/APIs: core/agent_runtime.py, core/api_docs.py, core/budget.py, core/budget_allocator.py

_note: Phase 1 delivered + validated (pytest 16 passed, compileall, api-governance in sync, wired-audit unwired 0)
